nodes.body:
QG-32b itself remains correctly recorded as lacking independent MILP closure (the frozen MILP timed out), so its own prospectively frozen verification contract was not rewritten post-outcome. A separate post-result independent replication was registered as QG-32c #928 / draft PR #929 and is now GREEN.

QG-32c independently reconstructed the observation problem and used exact 2+2 meet-in-the-middle cover decision; it confirmed **no <=4 fixed indexed-probe separator**. Its generic verifier used a distinct exact MITM ordering/filter implementation; native/replay/tamper gates all passed.

Combined with QG-32's already-certified 5-probe separator, exact fixed minimum `5` is now earned at the programme level for the frozen indexed local-response identity query after joint bulk+spectrum summaries. This promotion is supported by QG-32 + QG-32c, not by laundering QG-32b's timed-out independent lane.
